# Science and Education Publishing

> > Science and Education Publishing is a comprehensive open access academic publishing platform hosting 100+ peer-reviewed journals across multidisciplinary fields with integrated manuscript tracking and submission systems.

Science and Education Publishing (sciepub.com) operates as a multidisciplinary open access publisher providing peer-reviewed journals, books, and conference directories. The platform emphasizes accessibility to research across education, medicine, agriculture, mathematics, social sciences, and technology fields through its centralized journal portal and manuscript management system.

## Core Portal & Discovery

- [Home](https://sciepub.com/portal/index): Science and Education Publishing homepage showcasing 100+ open access journals across multidisciplinary fields.
- [All Journals](https://sciepub.com/portal/journals): Main journals directory for Science and Education Publishing's open access peer-reviewed publications.
- [Browse by Subject](https://sciepub.com/portal/journalbysubject): Subject-based browsing interface for Science and Education Publishing's journal catalog.
- [Browse by Category](https://sciepub.com/portal/CategoryOfJournal): Journal category browsing and organization interface for Science and Education Publishing.
- [Journals A-Z](https://sciepub.com/portal/journalbyletter): Alphabetical directory of all open access journals published by Science and Education Publishing.
- [Free Journals](https://sciepub.com/portal/journalbyfree): Directory of free open access journals from Science and Education Publishing.

## Research Content & Collections

- [Open Access Articles](https://sciepub.com/portal/articles): Open access articles directory and portal for scientific research publications.
- [Special Issues](https://sciepub.com/Portal/allspecialissues): Directory of special issues and call for papers across Science and Education Publishing journals.
- [Academic Books](https://sciepub.com/portal/books): Open access academic books and publications from Science and Education Publishing.
- [Conferences](https://sciepub.com/portal/conferenceslist): Directory of academic conferences and research events hosted by Science and Education Publishing.

## Featured Journals

- [American Journal of Educational Research](https://sciepub.com/journal/EDUCATION): American Journal of Educational Research journal homepage and article portal.
- [American Journal of Medical Case Reports](https://sciepub.com/journal/AJMCR): American Journal of Medical Case Reports peer-reviewed medical journal.
- [American Journal of Public Health Research](https://sciepub.com/journal/AJPHR): American Journal of Public Health Research open access health sciences journal.
- [International Journal of Celiac Disease](https://sciepub.com/journal/IJCD): International Journal of Celiac Disease open access medical research journal.
- [World Journal of Agricultural Research](https://sciepub.com/journal/WJAR): World Journal of Agricultural Research open access agriculture and food sciences journal.
- [Turkish Journal of Analysis and Number Theory](https://sciepub.com/journal/TJANT): Turkish Journal of Analysis and Number Theory open access mathematics journal.
- [Journal of Sociology and Anthropology](https://sciepub.com/journal/JSA): Journal of Sociology and Anthropology open access social science research journal.

## Author Services & Submission

- [Manuscript Tracking System](http://mts.sciepub.com): Author portal for manuscript submission, tracking, and account management.

## News & Updates
